gnpa_ratio.label: Gross NPA
gnpa_ratio.definition: Gross non-performing advances divided by gross advances at the same date; includes global standalone operations.

net_npa_ratio.label: Net NPA
net_npa_ratio.definition: Net non-performing advances divided by reported net advances at date. Eligible regulatory deductions can differ from balance-sheet net advances; reconciliation to reported ratio is required.

cost_income_ratio.label: Cost / income
cost_income_ratio.definition: Annual operating expenses / (net interest income + other income); provisions and taxes excluded.

casa_ratio.label: Global CASA
casa_ratio.definition: Closing global current and savings deposits / closing global deposits. Do not substitute domestic CASA.

nim.label: Net interest margin
nim.definition: Annual NII / average interest-earning assets. Quarterly values require annualization and consistent average asset basis.

roa.label: Return on assets
roa.definition: Annual PAT / average assets; reported ratios retained, not rebuilt from closing assets.

roe.label: Return on equity
roe.definition: Annual attributable earnings / average ordinary equity; equivalent shareholder perimeter required.

credit_cost.label: Credit cost
credit_cost.definition: Issuer reported annual credit-cost ratio; provision scope and averaging require verification before reconstruction.

slippage_ratio.label: Slippages
slippage_ratio.definition: Issuer reported annual ratio; do not confuse fresh slippages with all NPA additions.

pcr_including_two_ratio.label: Provision coverage incl. technical write-offs
pcr_including_two_ratio.definition: Issuer PCR including technical write-offs; distinct from on-balance-sheet provisions/GNPA.

cost_of_deposits.label: Cost of deposits
cost_of_deposits.definition: Annual deposit interest expense / average deposits; this is not full cost of funds.

cost_of_funds.label: Cost of funds
cost_of_funds.definition: Interest cost / consistent average interest-bearing funding including borrowing; unavailable.

capital_ratio.label: Basel III capital
capital_ratio.definition: Regulatory capital / risk-weighted assets. Neither simple ratio averaging nor ordinary equity/total assets is valid.

eps_basic.label: Basic EPS
eps_basic.definition: Attributable annual earnings / weighted-average ordinary shares; merger swap and capital issuance prevent direct historical aggregation.

book_value_per_share.label: Book value / share
book_value_per_share.definition: Consistent ordinary book equity / actual ending shares; do not mix share application money or revaluation conventions.

comparability.note: Use global standalone bank figures throughout. The issuer disclosed pooling of interests under AS 14 in its June 2019 results note. This is not acquisition/fair-value accounting. The word consolidated in opening amalgamation slides sometimes means combined three banks, whereas statutory consolidated statements include subsidiaries. Eliminations and reserve adjustments still require review.
FY2020 PAT546.18 follows pretax loss1802.11 and tax credit2348.29. A positive PAT is not proof of improved operations; underlying tax recognition needs separate review.

Capital infusion and share issuance accompany merger; EPS and capital ratios cannot be attributed to merger operations without isolating issuance.

interpretation.finding: The combined GNPA ratio fell during the first year, but fell less than either selected peer and improved below the premerger baseline in only the fourth postmerger quarter. Arithmetic supports a descriptive improvement; evidence does not establish merger-caused improvement.
interpretation.counterargument: Integration may yield benefits later; these peers have very different starting risks, and RBI reclassification changes the historical baseline. A weak first-year peer gap can understate eventual operating gains.
interpretation.falsification: A fully reconciled predecessor series, comparable relief-adjusted post data, stable favourable peer gaps across defensible peer sets and at least four sustained post-transition quarters would challenge the current inconclusive attribution.

The earlier issuer baseline of 53.19% conflicts with the later 52.01% disclosure. Latest underlying amounts are used; original version is quarantined, not erased.
Accounting and one-offs are unquantified and remain in the residual; sector is unavailable.

comparisons.reason: Annual cost/income improves against the three-bank baseline, while remaining above the acquirer-only level. Prior-year amalgamation expenses and other-income composition are not isolated, and no validated peer counterfactual is available.

executiveFinding: The combined GNPA ratio fell during the first year, but fell less than either selected peer and improved below the premerger baseline in only the fourth postmerger quarter. Arithmetic supports a descriptive improvement; evidence does not establish merger-caused improvement.
subtitle: 2019 statutory amalgamation · first-year historical comparison · evidence reviewed 16 October 2026

challenge.counterargument: Integration may yield benefits later; these peers have very different starting risks, and RBI reclassification changes the historical baseline. A weak first-year peer gap can understate eventual operating gains.
challenge.falsification: A fully reconciled predecessor series, comparable relief-adjusted post data, stable favourable peer gaps across defensible peer sets and at least four sustained post-transition quarters would challenge the current inconclusive attribution.

synergies.caution: Operational milestones do not establish realized financial savings; FY2019 one-offs and treasury gains contaminate cost/income comparison.
